Class NettyPythonEventLoop.NettyServer

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.python.netty.NettyPythonEventLoop.NettyServer
Enclosing class:
NettyPythonEventLoop
public static final class NettyPythonEventLoop.NettyServer extends Object
Netty-backed asyncio server exposed to Python as a host object.

Like transports, this host object exposes snake_case members because asyncio server helpers call names such as start_serving, serve_forever, and wait_closed directly.
